title: Subaru High-z Exploration of Low-Luminosity Quasars (SHELLQs). III. Star formation properties of the host galaxies at z ≳ 6 studied with ALMA
question: What are the star formation properties, sizes, dynamical masses and black hole-host mass relation of low-luminosity (M1450 > -25) quasar hosts at z >~ 6, compared with optically luminous quasars?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 9.5, 20.7, 13.2, 8.8 uJy/beam; [CII] 0.12-0.24 mJy/beam per 50 km/s

what.value: Literature compilation of z>~6 quasar [CII], FIR, Mdyn, MBH and M1450 for comparison

evidence.quote: We have also compiled $M_{\rm BH}$ or $M_{\rm 1450}$

what.value: MBH of J0859+0022 and J2216-0016 from Mg II virial calibration

evidence.quote: See details about the $M_{\rm BH}$ measurement of J0859+0022 and J2216-0016 with the Mg -based calibrations (cite: 2009ApJ...699..800V) in M. Onoue et al. (in preparation).

recipe.method: Calibrate and clean with CASA; uv continuum subtraction; bin to 50 km/s
Single Gaussian fit of continuum-subtracted spectrum in 1.5 arcsec aperture; L_[CII] via standard equation

assumptions: Kroupa IMF; young stars heat [CII]; AGN contribution neglected; dispersion ~0.3 dex not in errors

recipe.goal: FIR luminosity, SFR_TIR and dust mass
recipe.method: Optically thin gray body to 1.2 mm flux; extend to TIR (8-1000 um); SFR=1.49e-10 L_TIR; Mdust from kappa
key_parameters: Td=47 K and 35 K, beta=1.6, kappa0=0.4 cm2/g at 250 GHz
assumptions: No CMB correction for Td >~ 35 K; star formation accounts for all TIR

recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fit to [CII] moment-0 and continuum maps in image plane, 3 sigma clipping, native resolution
CLUMPFIND on continuum-subtracted cubes, peak S/N>=5; continuum emitters at S/N>=5
key_parameters: Delta S = 1 sigma, S_start = 3 sigma; 43 MHz binning

recipe.goal: Dynamical mass and comparison with MS and MBH-Mdyn
recipe.method: Thin-disk Mdyn=1.16e5 vcirc^2 D; i from axis ratio; compare with nu2GC and local relation
assumptions: Mdyn used as surrogate for M*; Eddington-limited accretion for BH mass of two quasars

evidence.quote: The line FWHM ranges from 192 to 356 km s$^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: ODR fit of log L[CII]/LFIR vs log LFIR

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel selection and velocity ranges for moment-0 maps
Clean mask, threshold and iteration settings; image size
CASA task parameters for imfit (regions, initial guesses)
Dust-temperature SED details for the gray body integration and L_FIR band definition
Details of nu2GC selection and M_BH from Onoue et al.
Which archive products or scripts were used (pipeline vs manual)
missing_for_reproduction: Line-free channel ranges and moment velocity ranges
score_reason: Data public and recipe mostly specified, but several imaging and analysis details are missing and some inputs are unpublished.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, clear CASA recipe and numeric results (fluxes, sizes, luminosities).
